chapters.title: The beginning of the gospel
chapters.summary: Mark begins quickly: John baptizes Jesus, He is tested in the wilderness, calls fishermen, and heals many in Capernaum. He rises before dawn to pray.

chapters.title: Through the roof
chapters.summary: Friends lower a paralyzed man through a roof, and Jesus forgives and heals him. He eats with tax collectors and says the Sabbath was made for people.

chapters.title: The twelve chosen
chapters.summary: Jesus heals a withered hand on the Sabbath, appoints twelve apostles, and says His family are those who do God's will.

chapters.title: The sower and the storm
chapters.summary: Jesus teaches the parables of the sower and the mustard seed, then calms a storm: Peace, be still. Why are you so fearful?

chapters.title: Power over demons, illness and death
chapters.summary: Jesus frees a man possessed by Legion, heals a woman who touches His cloak, and raises Jairus' daughter: be not afraid, only believe.

chapters.title: Feeding five thousand
chapters.summary: Jesus is rejected in Nazareth, sends out the twelve, feeds five thousand, and walks on the water to the frightened disciples.

chapters.title: From the heart
chapters.summary: Jesus says evil comes from within, not from unwashed hands. A Gentile woman's faith is honored, and a deaf man hears.

chapters.title: Who do you say I am?
chapters.summary: Jesus feeds four thousand. Peter confesses Him as the Christ. Jesus foretells His death and asks: what does it profit to gain the whole world and lose your soul?

chapters.title: Help my unbelief
chapters.summary: Jesus is transfigured. A father cries, "Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief," and his son is healed. Whoever wants to be first must be servant of all.

chapters.title: The Son of Man came to serve
chapters.summary: Jesus blesses children, the rich man goes away sad, and blind Bartimaeus receives his sight. The Son of Man came to serve and give His life as a ransom.

chapters.title: Entering Jerusalem
chapters.summary: Jesus rides into Jerusalem, curses a fig tree, clears the temple as a house of prayer for all nations, and teaches about faith and forgiveness.

chapters.title: The widow's offering
chapters.summary: Jesus answers questions on taxes, resurrection and the greatest commandment, and praises a poor widow who gave all she had.

chapters.title: Watch
chapters.summary: Jesus foretells the temple's fall, troubles and His return. No one knows the day or hour, so stay awake.

chapters.title: Gethsemane
chapters.summary: A woman anoints Jesus. At the Last Supper He gives bread and cup. In Gethsemane He prays, "Abba, Father, not what I will," and is arrested. Peter denies Him.

chapters.title: The cross
chapters.summary: Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified. He is mocked and dies, and the temple curtain tears in two. The centurion says, truly this man was the Son of God.

chapters.title: The empty tomb
chapters.summary: Women find the stone rolled away and a young man says, He is risen. Jesus appears to His followers and sends them into all the world to preach the gospel.
